worldcombat.skill.psyblade.summary: Forms an almost invisible psychic blade and thrusts a narrow straight line in the chosen direction; standing on electric terrain charges the blade, raising its power and extending it along the same line so a whole row can be pierced. A solid wall truncates the line, and leaving the terrain restores the short blade next cast.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.use.0: Land a heavy thrust while on the electric-terrain charge
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.use.1: Pierce a row of foes with one line while on the charge
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.use.2: Sever a foe's guard with an unseen blade
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.description.0: Deals about %1$s contact physical damage to each foe thrust through; while the caster stands on the electric-terrain charge this segment is x1.5.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.description.1: Steps up to a target within %1$s blocks (dash speed about %2$s blocks/tick), then thrusts a narrow %3$s block half-width line; every non-ally on the line takes one hit.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.description.2: While the caster stands on the electric-terrain charge the line extends about %1$s blocks farther along the same direction; anyone hit is shoved about %2$s blocks away. A solid wall truncates the line, so nothing behind it is hit.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.extend.on: Row mode: the charged extension is x1.3 and the line is longer for piercing a row, but power x0.88, +2 ticks windup and +3 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.extend.off: Focus mode: a shorter, heavier line, faster and cheaper, good for singling one target out.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s windup it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.growth.0: From level %1$s the blade power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.growth.1: From level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the charged extension grows longer.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.preference.ex: On (row mode): while charged the extension is x1.3 and the line is longer to pierce a row, but power x0.88, +2 ticks windup and +3 ticks cooldown. Off (focus, default): a shorter, heavier line, faster and cheaper, good for singling one target out.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; psyblade is melee, so this is smaller than a ranged move's.

On: prioritise the thrust while the caster stands on the electric-terrain charge, where it is x1.5 and the line is longer, and favour lined-up targets to pierce; off: ignore terrain and rank it as an ordinary melee thrust.
On: prioritise this heavy thrust against targets below four tenths health; off: ignore health in the ranking.
